produced_at_note: This manifest carries no wall-clock timestamp on purpose: every field is derived from repository bytes so the file is byte-reproducible from the recorded inputs.

contract.consumer: Intended input for `node tooling/brain/knowledge.mjs propose --batch <manifest> --run <run>` (Phase 5 command template, plan §Phase 5).
contract.consumer_status: NOT YET EXECUTABLE. tooling/brain/knowledge.mjs exposes only `propose --pilot`, `verify`, `apply`; there is no `--batch` or `sample` surface, and `proposeKnowledge` hard-fails outside 8-12 candidates and requires a `rejected_candidates` array. Engine work is out of this lane's ownership.
contract.forbidden: This file must not be read as a candidate fixture. It deliberately contains no concept_id, title, alias, canonical_path, tag, or locator span for any new concept.

ordering.rule: repo-relative POSIX path, ascending byte-wise (LC_ALL=C) UTF-8 comparison
ordering.grouping: extraction sources first, then rejection probes; each group independently byte-sorted

hash_lock.encoding: lowercase hex over complete raw-layer file bytes
hash_lock.batch_baseline_recipe: sha256 of the UTF-8 concatenation of `<role>\t<path>\t<source_sha256>\n` for every entry in order_index order (extraction rows first, then rejection_probe rows)
hash_lock.batch_baseline_reproduce: { for f in content/brain/books/do-it-java/chap09.md content/brain/books/do-it-java/chap10.md; do printf "extraction\t%s\t%s\n" "$f" "$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; done; for f in content/brain/books/headfirst/chap01.md content/brain/books/kafka/chap03.md content/brain/books/kafka/chap04.md; do printf "rejection_probe\t%s\t%s\n" "$f" "$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; done; } | shasum -a 256
hash_lock.book_corpus_recipe: sha256 of the UTF-8 concatenation of `<path>\t<source_sha256>\n` for all 27 content/brain/books Markdown files in LC_ALL=C path order
hash_lock.seed_use: batch_baseline_sha256 is the deterministic seed required by AC-15 for the U3 `sample.json` selection. Any source drift changes the seed and invalidates a prior sample.
hash_lock.drift_policy: fail-closed. Re-verify every source_sha256 immediately before propose and again before apply; a mismatch aborts the batch with zero writes.

selection_rationale.scheduling_hint: Plan §Phase 5 initial scheduling hint ranks Book first. This batch stays inside that hint (hint, not an acceptance criterion).
selection_rationale.primary: chap09 (추상 클래스) and chap10 (인터페이스) are the direct successors of the signed pilot chapter do-it-java/chap08 (상속과 다형성). They are the only unconsumed Book sources whose evidence lands on the already-signed java.oop.* namespace, so they exercise the update/merge-against-existing-index path that the pilot (all create, plus one merge into a brand-new concept) never tested.
selection_rationale.bounded: Two extraction files, 47,477 bytes, 37 heading scopes of which 31 carry prose. That is the smallest slice that still forces every risky Phase 5 code path, and it is cheap to regenerate if U3 rejects the batch (plan §5.1: one critical issue rejects the whole batch).
selection_rationale.probes: Three frontmatter-only Book files are hash-locked as rejection probes. They cost no review effort, and they prove the insufficient-source-evidence path fails closed on the Book corpus the same way it did on the notes corpus in the pilot.
rejected_alternatives: do-it-java chap05-07 added: +46 heading scopes of mostly `create` work, doubling U3 surface for validation signal the pilot already covered. Recommended as batch 02.
Kafka series first: largest yield by bytes but zero adjacency to the signed index, so it would defer the update/merge validation that is the actual first-batch risk.
Re-reading chap08/dinosaur chap01: would re-propose over spans already signed at U2.

expected_candidate_profile.disclaimer: Ranges and touch points only. No concept_id, title, canonical_path, alias, or tag is authored here; candidate authoring is a separate step.

expected_kinds.create: majority - abstract-class, template-method, final-keyword, interface, default/static/private interface member families
expected_kinds.update: expected against already-signed concept ids where chap09/chap10 add new evidence: java.oop.polymorphism (chap10 L160-181, L182-318), java.oop.inheritance (chap10 L784-909, L910-1018), java.oop.method-overriding (chap09 L83-226), java.oop.virtual-method (chap10 L141-157)
expected_kinds.merge: possible where chap09 and chap10 describe the same mechanism (for example type conversion evidence appearing in both); resolution belongs to the engine, not this manifest
expected_kinds.stub: at most 1-2 low-evidence scopes; chap09 `### final 메서드` (L735-740, 1 prose line) is the clearest candidate
expected_kinds.no_op: expected on rerun; AC-14 requires rerun no-op
expected_kinds.rejected: exactly 3, all rejection probes, reason_code insufficient-source-evidence

expected_flagged_for_full_review.rule: plan §5.1 requires 100% review of conflict / low-confidence / provenance-warning proposals

preconditions.statement: The 11 U2-signed pilot concepts are approved but NOT applied: content/brain/knowledge/ still contains only index.md (sha256 8fe2295874df441edf4183ce248a37527e908c9a397abb3292f0c475c5b39f8c). knowledge-index.mjs builds the approved index from that tree, so today it is empty.
preconditions.consequence: If batch 01 proposes before the pilot is applied, every expected `update`/`merge` degrades to `create` and duplicate concepts for polymorphism / inheritance / method-overriding / virtual-method enter the graph.

preconditions.statement: knowledge.mjs has no `--batch` or `sample` command, and proposeKnowledge enforces 8-12 candidates plus a `rejected_candidates` array.
preconditions.consequence: This manifest cannot be executed yet, and the expected 14-22 candidate range would trip the pilot-era 8-12 guard if the batch runner reuses it.

preconditions.statement: All five batch sources are untracked in git (`??`), so the raw layer is uncommitted working-tree state rather than a committed baseline.
preconditions.consequence: Source drift cannot be detected by git alone; the hash lock in this manifest is the only drift guard.

preconditions.statement: Raw book frontmatter carries display tags such as `📚 Do it! 자바`. Knowledge `tags[]` must equal the canonical_path folder segments, and `brain`/`knowledge` are reserved.
preconditions.consequence: Propagating raw book tags into knowledge documents violates the Phase 4 tag invariant.

preconditions.statement: Owner decision H-1: knowledge aliases are search-only. `aliases`/`alias`/`permalink` are forbidden in knowledge frontmatter because Quartz emits a public redirect route per entry.
preconditions.consequence: Alias handling for batch 01 must reuse the pilot's KNOWLEDGE_ALIASES body-block rendering.
